{{Top}}
[[File:Generator_TOR.jpg|thumb|right|200px|A power generator on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]]]
{{Quote|Their primary target will be the power generators.|General Carlist Rieekan, during the Battle of Hoth|<ref name="Episode 5">{{Film|V}}</ref>}}
'''Power generators''' were used throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] to supply large amounts of power to [[City/Legends|cities]], bases, factories, [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], and [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] weapons. Smaller power generators existed which were able to provide continuous power for portable heavy weapons, vehicles, structures, and machinery.<ref name="Saga Edition Core Rulebook">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Saga Edition Core Rulebook]]''</ref> Both the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]] used power generators at their bases to keep their [[Communications array/Legends|communications arrays]], base [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]], [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] towers, and mining facilities functioning at peak levels. They were also used by numerous other factions such as the [[Zann Consortium/Legends|Zann Consortium]] and the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]].
[[File:PowerGenerator-TESB.png|thumb|left|150px|A [[DSS-02 shield generator/Legends|DSS-02 shield generator]]]]
Power generators were used to power weapon emplacements and shields most of the time, but bases that were not high priority or not well funded sometimes used them as primary power sources. Their one major flaw was that they did not take battle damage well. A well-placed [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] shot would cause them to breakdown and stop working.

During the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], [[Major General]] [[Maximilian Veers/Legends|Maximilian Veers]]' [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-AT]] ''[[Blizzard 1/Legends|Blizzard 1]]'' was able to easily destroy the [[DSS-02 shield generator/Legends|generator]] and power down the shield which had protected the Rebel troops' fleeing transports from bombardment by the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] above the planet.

The main reason power generators were so common was that they could could run on many different power sources, natural or otherwise; the one on Hoth, for example, was powered by geothermal activity. [[AlderaanMotors/Legends|AlderaanMotors]] was one manufacturer of power generators.
